payload.input:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /Users/divadbaroon/Projects/chess-stats/blunders.py
+import chess, chess.engine, chess.pgn
+
+ME = "dbarron_runs"
+eng = chess.engine.SimpleEngine.popen_uci("/opt/homebrew/bin/stockfish")
+phase_count = {"opening": 0, "middlegame": 0, "endgame": 0, "none": 0}
+losses = []
+with open("games.pgn") as f:
+    while (g := chess.pgn.read_game(f)):
+        h = g.headers
+        if h.get("TimeControl") != "180+2":
+            continue
+        side = chess.WHITE if h["White"] == ME else chess.BLACK
+        if h["Result"] == ("0-1" if side == chess.WHITE else "1-0"):
+            losses.append((g, side))
+for g, side in losses[-50:]:
+    b = g.board(); prev = None; found = "none"
+    for i, mv in enumerate(g.mainline_moves()):
+        b.push(mv)
+        sc = eng.analyse(b, chess.engine.Limit(depth=14))["score"].pov(side).score(mate_score=10000)
+        if prev is not None and b.turn != side and prev - sc >= 200:
+            pieces = len(b.piece_map())
+            found = "opening" if i < 20 else "endgame" if pieces <= 12 else "middlegame"
+            break
+        prev = sc
+    phase_count[found] += 1
+eng.quit()
+print(phase_count)
*** End Patch
